Triptych therefore records the exact remote bytes and their digest, retains no payload, and quotes from the underlying edition only what a locus needs.

edition.notes: A diplomatic edition: the manuscript's nomina sacra and other contractions are printed as the codex has them (Dne, Ds, Spm, scs), and the editor's supplements stand in round brackets. Both properties matter to any mechanical comparison against a modern missal's expanded orthography.

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The earliest surviving collection of Roman Mass formularies, a libellus collection copied at Verona in the earlier seventh century and preserving material of the fifth and sixth. It is not an ordered sacramentary and has no Advent or Lent; its formularies run by month from April. Long called Leonine on an attribution to Leo the Great that is not now maintained, and catalogued under both names.
work.title: Sacramentarium Veronense
